delivery_semantics: ephemeral application request/reply; every measured request must return its matching result

topologies.swarmwire_peer_unix: direct Unix peer sockets; native discovery/authentication/artifact broker on control plane only
topologies.swarmwire_peer_tcp: direct loopback TCP peer sockets; native Unix discovery/authentication/artifact control plane only
topologies.swarmwire_auto_unix: Unix peers and native Unix broker multiplexing; configurable threshold 16 warm routes, automatic reply path
topologies.swarmwire_auto_tcp: TCP peers and native TCP broker multiplexing; configurable threshold 16 warm routes, automatic reply path
topologies.zeromq_inproc: direct same-process PUSH/PULL mesh; raw SDK uses REQ/REP
topologies.swarmwire_unix: separate native broker, Unix sockets, Python workers in harness process, per-send ACK
topologies.swarmwire_unix_stream: same native Unix broker, no positive per-send ACK
topologies.zeromq_ipc: direct Unix-socket PUSH/PULL mesh; raw SDK uses REQ/REP
topologies.zeromq_tcp: direct loopback TCP PUSH/PULL mesh; raw SDK uses REQ/REP
topologies.swarmwire_tcp: separate native broker, loopback TCP, per-send ACK
topologies.swarmwire_tcp_stream: same native TCP broker, no positive per-send ACK
topologies.nats_core: separate official NATS server, loopback TCP; no JetStream

notes: Agent workloads share the same Python interpreter, loop, Agent envelope, payloads, handlers, deadlines and verification across modes.
Native API workloads measure direct pyzmq REQ/REP, nats-py request/respond, or SwarmWire RawRPC; no Agent wrapper or JSON. RawRPC adds a 13-byte correlation envelope to the application bytes.
The common outer deadline bounds every direct SDK request; nats-py request(timeout=None) and RawRPC(timeout=None) avoid redundant SDK timers while preserving that deadline.
Topology and per-send acceptance semantics differ; application reply completion is the shared measurement boundary.
SwarmWire acknowledged modes wait for broker acceptance; streaming, ZeroMQ and Core NATS sends do not.
Direct peers reserve one bounded receive slot per connection, return credits with outgoing data, and warm discovery/authentication before timing.
No model/API calls, durable storage, forced competitor delays or omitted losing trials.
All setup and route warmup occur before timing; agent text length excludes JSON metadata; raw payload_bytes is exact.
